notes.title: Proportions is now Free to Play!
notes.content:
🛠️ Proportions is now Free to Play!
Hey everyone 👋

It’s been a while since the last update, and I wanted to share with you — in full transparency — what’s been going on behind the scenes.
[hr][/hr]🎯 The original plan
My goal was to let as many people as possible play together, even if only one person owned the game. So I spent the last couple of months working on a “friend pass” version of Proportions.

Unfortunately, I ran into technical limitations with how Steam handles AppIDs, and after many attempts, I had to accept that this approach just wasn’t going to work.
[hr][/hr]🆓 The game is now free
Instead of continuing to fight against these constraints, I’ve made a simple decision:
➡️ Proportions is now completely free for everyone.

I believe this is the best way to grow the community and make it easier for friends to play together without barriers.
[hr][/hr]🎁 A thank-you to early supporters
To everyone who purchased the game before this change:
thank you so much for your support ❤️

You helped bring this project to life, and as a token of appreciation, you’re receiving exclusive customization options (🎩 hats) in this update.
[hr][/hr]🔜 What’s next? Finding a sustainable path
Now that the game is free, I’ll keep working on new content and improvements — but I’m also exploring a new business model to make the game sustainable in the long run.

🧠 What I want to avoid:
I have no intention of turning Proportions into a pay-to-win game. Fairness and fun will always come first.

💡 What I’m considering:

Cosmetic items (more hats, accessories, skins…)

Map or game mode DLCs

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Important: If one player owns a map DLC, everyone in their session will be able to play it, even if they don’t own it themselves. The goal is to never split the community.

These ideas are still in development, and I’d love to hear your feedback. The goal is simple: to keep Proportions growing while finding a way to make it financially viable, without compromising the player experience.
[hr][/hr]
Thanks again for your patience and support.
Feel free to leave a review, share the game with friends, or join the community to give your thoughts!

See you soon in Proportions!
— Killian

notes.title: Vehicles update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217728/3dab08f76e9b312a4f2305309e9131ac3714603c.png

 In this update, vehicles have been added to allow minis to move quickly and in groups. Additionally, the way objectives steps are scaled in classic game mode has been changed, allowing players to choose the exact number of steps to complete.

notes.title: Colossal Update: New Modes, New Challenges
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217728/aa1e31e4830f5352e3275890c5a25a5a1b0fdea7.png
Giants, Minis, I heard you !

Thanks to the numerous feedback and advice, I have been able to work on a veeeery big update.
On the menu: a new game mode. Goodbye mini-games, hello cooperative collection!
A new depth of gameplay is appearing: complete your objective or drive the giant crazy! (However, he might not like that too much.)

Explanation of the new collection game mode:
Find and bring more or less heavy objects to the dimensional doors to win the game. Light objects can be carried alone, but for the others, you will have to do it together.

Explanation of the Giant's madness system:
Different equipment can be broken by two. If the giant does not repair them, his mental health will decrease. If the giant has no more mental health, he falls into madness and sees the minis through the walls. If he manages to catch a mini within the allotted time, his mental health goes up a bit, otherwise the minis win.

Bugs fixed:

The "Give up" option did not deactivate after the death of a mini.
If no player chooses the giant at the start of a game, a giant will be chosen randomly.
If the giant clicks to catch while he has a mini in hand, he will then look at it.
A tutorial has been added during the game.
The reverb of the giant's footsteps could cause lags, it has been removed for now.
Next steps:
I plan to change the event system and replace it with bonus boxes to find. New bonuses will also be added, such as fireworks to blind the giant, a robot vacuum that helps the giant, and vehicles.

notes.title: Pipes Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217728/0c8c181ef4270649bd1a3fba4011020dc4f6451e.jpg
New Features:

Fast Travel Pipes: Pipes have been added to the maps, allowing minis to move very quickly from one corner to another. Enjoy this new feature for even more dynamic strategies!

Bug Fixes:

Giant Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where the giant could get stuck in an objective. The giant can now move freely without encountering this issue.

notes.title: Event Update !
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217728/f9a36ab29f66fef51ca3d5f1ae5f39f52aa95f1d.png

Hello Proportions players!

We’re thrilled to bring you an exciting update packed with new features and events to enhance your gameplay experience:

Wanted Event: Keep an eye out for the new “Wanted” posters! These posters will feature a random mini’s face and their environment, adding a fun and engaging twist to your adventures.

Trails Event: Watch as your minis leave behind colorful trails when they move. This new visual effect adds a dynamic and vibrant touch to the game.

Surrender Option: Trapped and no way out? Now, when a mini is the last one standing and finds themselves trapped, they have the option to surrender, allowing the game to end gracefully.

We hope you enjoy these new additions and look forward to your feedback!
